text: I use this as a replacement for Astrid. What bothers me is that it keeps reminding me of tasks although I have not specified any time or alarm or something to pop up. I miss different priorities and that I can't schedule repeating tasks for more than one day a week. In Astrid, you could specify that a task be repeated Tuesdays and Thursdays, e.g. On TickTick, I have two create two tasks: one that repeats on Tuesdays, one for Thursdays.
author: Ein Google-Nutzer
developer_reply:
1. If you don't set a reminder, the pop-up or alarm will never appear. Would you please check your settings gain?
2. We will offer different levels of priorities later. 
3. You can set a task to be repeated on different days. Click the Ndays when set a task as recurring.
